scope: Nested source-patient robustness and locked developmental anatomical transfer. No untouched external or clinical validation.

source.scope: Nested source-patient development robustness, excluding reused unseen26 assessment
limits: Development cohorts were used in prior research; no untouched validation
Bootstrap conditions on fitted models, not full nested-procedure refits
Mask-derived measurements are automated proxies, not expert anatomy
Synthetic multiplicative measurement stress is not scanner or segmentation validation
Retrospective horizons are not prospective next-visit timing

source_single_visit_companion.scope: Predeclared secondary scoring of the same saved out-of-fold predictions; no refitting or primary endpoint change

transfer.scope: Locked LUMIERE-source numerical models on reused developmental SAILOR patients; no target-cohort adaptation
limits: SAILOR has been reused; this is developmental transfer, not untouched external validation
Different automated mask sources are not verified biological truth
MNI interval metadata are approximate retrospective queries
No SAILOR clinical label mapping or clinical transfer tested
No uncertainty or model recalibration on SAILOR

verification.scope: Prediction and scorer replay, not independent review or full inner-selection replay

post_assessment_auc_diagnostic.reason: Pooled OOF prevalence probabilities differ by fold and can have AUROC below 0.5. These within-fold AUROCs diagnose cross-fold probability ranking and do not replace the primary log-loss endpoint.

source.runtime_scope: Two-row numerical fitting; full nested controls expected to take minutes on mosaic-gpu

limits: Source cohorts and SAILOR were used previously; this is developmental evidence
Current-state gains over persistence do not isolate history benefit
Previous response rating is a supplied retrospective annotation, not certified prospective availability
No verified clinical-response mapping for SAILOR
Pooled cross-fitted AUROC can reflect fold-specific probability calibration; log loss remained primary
Synthetic multiplicative volume perturbations do not validate automated masks or scanner robustness
No independent scientific review or rescue sweep
